snippet.title: Mystic Pathways | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #MysticPathways 

🧚Mystic Pathways Launch Trailer🧚
💎 Available for Playstation, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Microsoft Store!

Embark on a magical journey with Mystic Pathways, a puzzle game that challenges your logic and creativity. Manipulate enchanted trails on a beautifully designed hexagonal board to guide mystical fairies in collecting magical crystals and activating sacred altars.

KEY FEATURES:
💎30 Levels to play;
💎Discover breathtaking landscapes, from blooming meadows to enchanted forests and crystal caves;
💎An ethereal soundtrack and stunning artistic design;
💎Explore intuitive mechanics that evolve in complexity;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
🧚Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014677
🧚Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/mystic-pathways/9PL7C2RPVWM8
🧚Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/mystic-pathways-xbox-one/9pfjt5b7r4rp
🧚Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/mystic-pathways-windows/9p292r836sxb
